description: Return envelope i of a closed UTC day as the content check runner serves it (kept 7 days after the day), with its RFC 6962 audit path. This server recomputes: the envelope has the closed shape (digests, numbers, booleans, fixed words; no text), the leaf hash is sha256(0x00 || canonical envelope), the audit path rebuilds the root of the day record the ledger stores, and the runner's Ed25519 signature verifies under the key the ledger lists. An admission of version 0.4 names the check of such an envelope by its digest.

lookup.description: ok = the ledger was read and the record exists. absent = the ledger was read and there is no such record. A read that FAILED never appears here: it comes back as a tool error (isError: true), so a consumer can never mistake this server's own failure for a statement about the ledger's contents.
